content.text: Documented behavior is different from what's reported, but related: per `content/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/events-that-trigger-workflows.md` (~line 965), "In a public repository, scheduled workflows are automatically disabled when no repository activity has occurred in 60 days." Docs don't mention deleting the last committer's account as a trigger — that behavior isn't covered here, so I can't confirm it from these files.
